verdict.rationale: Pilot's pricing page claims 'Instant AI answers about past transactions and current cash flow, plus run scenarios to plan ahead,' and other pages describe cash-flow scenario modeling. That is AI-driven Q&A over the user's own financial data, plausibly delivered in the portal where real-time account data lives. Most other 'strategic insights' claims come from human CFOs and accountants, not AI. Missing for 10: evidence of proactive AI-generated insights or suggestions (rather than on-demand answers), in-depth documentation of the AI feature and where it appears in the portal, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
